subject: yes, treedepth;  R-hat on log prob?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: yes, treedepth;  R-hat on log prob?
parts:
I think there's more motivation for lp__
than for treedepth__.

If we can get at tree depth somehow, I think it's
useful. It doesn't need to be in the default print.

I'd like it in the print, but now that I think about it,
I'm afraid users might get confused by its R-hat.

R-hat for lp__ does make sense, right? Would it even
make sense to make it the one variable we monitor if
we have to pick one? I've noticed it's often on the low
side of the parameter effective samples.

- Bob

On 3/5/13 9:46 PM, Daniel Lee wrote:
> On Tue, Mar 5, 2013 at 3:13 PM, Bob Carpenter <ca...@alias-i.com <mailto:ca...@alias-i.com>> wrote:
>
> 3. It would be nice to include treedepth__ and lp__ as in RStan
>
>
> RStan outputs lp___, but not treedepth__. Do we want to output both?

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] yes, treedepth; R-hat on log prob?

Perhaps we can display min / max treedepth for each chain?
